name: 01_testConnection_ok
description: PASS sync-action: OM GET /system/version 2xx + Keboola GET /v2/storage/tokens/verify 2xx -> ValidationResult(success). Real bot token + real Storage token.

name: 02_testConnection_bad_host
description: FAIL sync-action: OM host unreachable -> connection error surfaced, non-zero exit. NOTE: OM /system/version is unauthenticated (spec 3.5), so a bad #bot_token is NOT surfaced by testConnection; a bad host is the recordable OM-side failure. See handoff FLAG on the testConnection bot-token gap. om_host is a non-secret lever, so the secrets merge does not defeat this case.

name: 03_listBuckets_ok
description: PASS sync-action: GET /v2/storage/buckets 2xx -> list of SelectElement bucket options. No OM call. Real Storage token.

name: 04_listBuckets_bad_storage_token
description: FAIL sync-action: Keboola Storage rejects the token (401/403) -> UserException -> exit 1. RECORD NOTE: to make the bad token actually reach Storage, record this case in a pass whose --secrets file omits #storage_token (otherwise the global secrets merge overrides the bad value with the real one). See tests/setup/README.md.

name: 05_run_catalog_full_first
description: PASS run (Tier-1, catalog only): empty snapshot/state -> E1 DatabaseService, E2 Database, E3 DatabaseSchema, E4 Table + E8 columns/datatypes + E9 primary keys all created. Report rows action=created; last_written_snapshot written. Pipelines/lineage OFF to isolate the catalog pass.

name: 06_run_catalog_incremental_second_run
description: PASS run (incremental, second run WITH state): identical config to 05 but in/state.json carries the prior bucket digests + snapshot_table pointer -> unchanged buckets skipped (report action=skipped_unchanged); nothing re-pushed. RECORD NOTE: record 05 then 06 with --chain-state so 05's out/state.json seeds 06's in/state.json (spec 2.3 advance-after-success). Pair with 05.

name: 07_run_full_refresh
description: PASS run: full_refresh=true ignores the per-bucket digests and re-reads/re-pushes every bucket even when state exists (spec 2.3 periodic full refresh). Catalog only. Complements 06 (the full_refresh ON vs OFF pair).

name: 08_run_pipelines_and_lineage
description: PASS run (all writers ON): E13 config->Pipeline + Tasks (taskSQL, downstreamTasks) + PipelineService, E14 flow->Pipeline, E15 pipeline status (GET /jobs/{id}/open-api-lineage -> PUT /pipelines/{fqn}/status), E16 declared PipelineLineage edges, E17 QueryLineage column edges (SQLGlot). Report shows created + lineage rows; Manual edges untouched.

name: 09_run_lineage_off
description: PASS run (lineage/pipelines OFF): write_lineage=false, write_column_lineage=false, write_pipelines=false -> NO PUT /lineage and NO PUT /pipelines calls; only the catalog pass runs. The write-on (08) vs write-off (09) pair for E16/E17 + pipelines.

name: 10_run_column_lineage_only
description: PASS run: E17 column-level SQL lineage ON, declared E16 OFF -> only QueryLineage edges emitted (SQLGlot over transformation SQL, source=QueryLineage). Unresolved parses are recorded action=unresolved in the report and DO NOT fail the run (exit 0). Isolates E17 from E16.

name: 11_run_merge_three_way
description: PASS run: merge_mode=three_way_merge (default) with a populated snapshot base -> when OM still matches our last-written value an owned field change PATCHes (action=updated); when a human diverged from the base OM is left untouched (action=skipped_diverged) + report row. RECORD NOTE: needs OM pre-seeded with an entity + a divergent curated field to exercise the skipped_diverged branch (see README); the updated branch needs a chained snapshot from a prior run.

name: 12_run_merge_keboola_wins
description: PASS run: merge_mode=keboola_always_wins -> a divergence between OM and the Keboola-derived value is overwritten (action=updated) instead of preserved. The three_way_merge (11) vs keboola_always_wins (12) pair. RECORD NOTE: same OM pre-seed as 11 to show the overwrite.

name: 13_run_failure_mode_collect_and_fail
description: FAIL run (exit 1): failure_mode=collect_and_fail -> a per-entity OM write failure (4xx/5xx on one entity) is collected, written to catalog_run_report (action=failed, write_always so it survives), and a UserException is raised at the END -> exit 1. RECORD NOTE: needs one OM entity write to fail deterministically (e.g. OM configured to reject one payload / a seeded conflict). See README.

name: 14_run_failure_mode_fail_fast
description: FAIL run (exit 1): failure_mode=fail_fast -> the FIRST per-entity write failure raises immediately (exit 1) rather than being collected. catalog_run_report still holds the failed row (write_always). RECORD NOTE: same failing-entity setup as 13.

name: 15_run_failure_mode_log_only
description: PASS run (exit 0): failure_mode=log_only -> a per-entity write failure is logged + written to catalog_run_report (action=failed) but the run still exits 0. The three failure_mode variants: collect_and_fail (13), fail_fast (14), log_only (15). RECORD NOTE: same failing-entity setup as 13.

name: 16_run_host_project_forward_token
description: PASS run (Tier-1 host project, forward_token path): NO #storage_token in config -> the component uses the injected KBC_TOKEN/KBC_URL (forward_token). Proves the headless single-project story (spec 3.2). RECORD NOTE: export a REAL read-only KBC_TOKEN (+ KBC_URL for the stack) in the shell for this recording; the secrets.json #storage_token must be absent for this pass so the row-token path is not taken. Every other success case exercises the remote-row #storage_token path, so together they cover both Tier-1 credential resolutions.

name: 17_run_ssh_tunnel_missing_block
description: FAIL run (exit 1, config validation, NO HTTP): use_ssh_tunnel=true with no 'ssh' block -> Configuration raises UserException at construction -> exit 1. Merge-safe: no ssh key is in secrets.json, so the merge cannot satisfy the requirement. Empty cassette expected.

name: 18_run_tier2_missing_manage_token
description: FAIL run (exit 1, config validation, NO HTTP): project_scope=all_projects with no #manage_token -> Configuration raises UserException -> exit 1 (the user chose Tier-2 but supplied no credential, spec 5.4/6.3). Merge-safe: #manage_token is deliberately NOT in the default secrets.json, so the merge cannot satisfy it. Empty cassette expected.

name: 19_run_tier2_all_projects
description: PASS run (Tier-2): project_scope=all_projects + #manage_token -> GET /manage/organizations[/{id}/projects] enumerate + POST /manage/projects/{id}/tokens mint a short-lived read-only Storage token per project -> catalog each project into ONE coherent OM catalog. Minted token is redacted from the cassette (body field 'token'). CONDITIONAL: needs a real manage:storage-tokens manage token (+ organization_id). If unavailable at record time, this ONE case is recorded later / against a mock; everything else is recorded now. Do NOT block the phase on it.

name: 20_run_tier2_degrade
description: PASS run (exit 0, Tier-2 graceful degradation): project_scope=all_projects + #manage_token whose scope is insufficient -> enumerate/mint fails on 401/403 -> the component degrades to the HOST project (forward_token), emits a prominent warning + a catalog_run_report row action=degraded, and still exits 0 (spec 5.4). CONDITIONAL: needs a scope-limited manage token (or a mocked 403); record later if unavailable. RECORD NOTE: also needs a real KBC_TOKEN for the host-project fallback.
